messages.en: The ocean's huge, isn't it? You can't even see land.
Yeah, that ship's already a long way from shore. Look, there's water all around!

senses.en_definition: An opponent, competitor, or enemy in a contest, conflict, or war.
A suitable partner or something that pairs well with another.
A person or thing equal to another in ability, strength, or quality.
The opposite of something in meaning, nature, or direction.
To oppose, resist, or compete against someone or something.

messages.en: Fancy another game against me tomorrow? You only just beat me last time.
Sure! But if you lose this time, don't go using being tired as an excuse again.
Haha, okay. Eight o'clock at our usual court. Deal?

senses.en_definition: Suitable, fitting, or deserving of something.
Having the abilities or qualifications required for something; eligible.
(Archaic) A person's appearance, manner, or behaviour.

messages.en: The job ad says they want someone with two years' experience. I've only got just over a year. Am I eligible to apply?
Have a look further down. It says internships count too. With yours included, you've got two years, right?
Oh, you're right. I missed that. In that case, I'll apply tonight.

senses.en_definition: Exceeding a specified amount, limit, or previous level; extra.
The amount left after something has been taken or spent; the remainder.
To a greater degree in comparison with someone or something else.

collocations.en: better; it would be better to

senses.en_definition: To a greater degree than before; increasingly.
In the expression lebih kurang: approximately; more or less.

messages.en: Shall we take the bus to the station? It's probably cheaper.
I'd rather take something faster. We're already running late. Let's just get a taxi.
